ivy (Design): Quick a11y pass on the compact toolbar + inline menus — noticed focus rings are very faint in light theme and keyboard users sometimes skip menu items when a menu closes. Can we triage?
sam (Frontend): Thanks. Repro steps please? I suspect outline color/width and our unmount-on-close animation.
ivy (Design): Tab to toolbar, open kebab on a card, then Tab -> focus jumps to page header instead of menu item. Screenshot attached.
rita (A11y): Two things to call out quickly: 1) focus needs to be visually distinct from selection; recommend outline >=3px with offset or a visible box-shadow; 2) don't remove interactive nodes from DOM during close animation — either trap focus while open or keep mounted with `data-closing` until `transitionend`. Also check `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`.
devon (QA): Repro on Win10+Chrome and macOS+VoiceOver. VoiceOver sometimes reads the button label twice on open 1, likely duplicate announcement from a live region + aria-expanded. I recorded a short clip.
sam (Frontend): Quick CSS stopgap I can ship now:
```
.toolbar button:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(10,10,10,0.12); outline-offset: 2px; }
```
And I will change menu logic to keep the node mounted until transitionend and call `focus()` on first menuitem on open.
ivy (Design): Neutral outline ok for now. We should avoid using the brand color for focus because it collides with selection states.
rita (A11y): Also: - Add `prefers-reduced-motion` for the menu animation; - Add `prefers-contrast: more` to increase outline width for users who need it; - Remove redundant `aria-live` announcements and rely on `aria-expanded` + proper roles.
devon (QA): I'll add a Cypress e2e: tab into toolbar, open menu, assert focus lands on first menu item, close menu and assert Shift+Tab returns to trigger. Will include VoiceOver/NVDA smoke.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for PR 2876 (staging)
sam (Frontend): I'll open PR 2876 with the CSS + DOM/focus fixes + tests and tag @ivy and @rita for review.
ivy (Design): Quick decision: ship the 3px neutral outline + keep menus mounted during animation + reduced-motion and high-contrast tweaks. Revisit focus color in the next design pass.
rita (A11y): :thumbsup: please add a short release note line and update the accessibility checklist entry so release engineers run the SR smoke tests.
devon (QA): Marking P2. Will run SR smoke once PR lands on staging and will post results here.
sam (Frontend): Will post PR link and screenshots when CI finishes.
